No blocking source findings in frozen `42c4a874d5e8ab0bfc7dbb97853245d8cb221e4c` against `a29301deb12411fa7753c2569df090caa0db8c74`. All 19 manifest file hashes match, including the canonical import correction.

- **Combined identity path:** geometry constructs the actual private `Inner` context and funded `OwnedState` observer. Both enter the existing normal-core private gate with the same source, decoder, lease/work and epoch. Core wrappers delegate to geometry, avoiding cross-universe typed fixtures. See [witness.rs](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-361487a2/rust/core/src/source_resources/witness.rs:39).
- **Feature boundary:** explicit test support requires tracking. Default and ordinary tracking normal libraries exclude the gate and runner by cfg. Geometry remains a core dev-dependency; no duplicate gate, proxy account or replacement-account attachment was introduced.
- **Locks and lifetimes:** stage callbacks execute outside channel/binding locks. Their trusted-callback limitation is documented accurately. Cleanup releases nested storage and external owners before the final Weak; assertions require pool residency to remain until Weak destruction and then reach zero. See [geometry witnesses](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-361487a2/rust/geometry/src/resource/gate_boundary_witnesses_tests.rs:24).
- **Meaningful assertions:** seven cases cover healthy lifetime, refused growth preservation, expired spare-capacity mutation, healthy/cancelled fresh-fault precedence, independently pre-stopped epoch, and existing observer precedence. They check ledger categories, overlap/copy charges, unchanged sharing usage, operation non-entry and precise channel outcomes.
- **Scope and size:** finite caps remain confined to unit/explicit test support. No parser/cache/ProductOwner activation or region/native/math changes. New modules are 50–205 lines; new functions remain below 150 lines.

**Pinned closure verdict:** the requested combined source-path gap is closed at the source-review level for `42c4`. This does not certify the parent’s assembled checkout.

**Execution holds remain:** all four wrappers/seven cases are uncompiled and unrun. Default/tracking exposure, reciprocal package-feature resolution, wasm compilation and strict Clippy still require parent validation. Global-free-before-refund has preserved source ordering and existing fixture assertions, but no executed evidence from this review.

No builds, jobs or edits were performed.
